description.en: The department the Division of Unemployment Insurance belongs to — the parent in the issuer chain, reached through the division document's `parentOrganization` and shown as the breadcrumb under the division's name. One organization can publish many forms; a Definition points at the office asking, and the chain says whose office it is.
description.es: El departamento al que pertenece la División de Seguro de Desempleo: el organismo matriz en la cadena del emisor.
